product_metadata.title: Kaufman - Ultrasoft, Plush 100% Combed Ring Spun Yarn Dye Cotton Velour Oversized 30” x 60” Highly Absorbent Quick Dry, Colorful Striped Beach Pool and Bath Towel (2-Pack)
features: 100% high quality combed ring spun cotton velour makes our towels feel soft and luxurious on your skin after the beach, pool or shower. The thick, plush texture of velour on one side and the cotton terry loops on the other side makes this a perfect and versatile quick dry, highly absorbent towel. The high quality 100% combed ring spun cotton is used to ensure optimum softness, absorbency durability and very low levels of lint from the towel during washing or use.

30in x 60in is the perfect size for the entire family -adults and children. These towels are generously size for use at home in the bathroom, at the pool or by the beach. They are designed to be easy to wash and dry as well as compact and versatile enough to pack and use for travel anywhere- beach, pool, lake, camp site, gym, and picnic grounds. The colorful multipack set allows each person to have their own individual large size towel.

The classic colorful bold yarn dye stripes in assorted sorbet colors with matching wide endhem and plush soft cotton absorbs moisture from your body while wrapping you in warmth and coziness. It is sure to become a favorite for use day after day.

We guarantee you will love and enjoy our towels. Our commitment to excellence ensures we will deliver to you the customer great service, style, quality and value. We stand behind every towel we sell and will do everything to ensure you are happy with your purchase

Easy Care: - Wash towels separately from other items of clothing to help decrease the transfer of towel lint to other pieces of clothing. - Use cold water to wash towels to avoid color bleeding. - Always use a mild detergent when washing towels. You may use a larger amount of detergent on towels that are heavily soiled. -Tumble dry on low To protect the longevity of your towel: - Do not use fabric softeners or bleach which can alter the look and feel of your towel.
description: Get ready for your next family trip to the beach and take this set of beautiful and plush cabana towels. Perfect for the beach, pool, and any outdoor activities. The multi-pack includes soft sorbet colored towels: Tangerine, Blueberry, Pistachio, Raspberry with a unique wide matching endhem . Everywhere you go, these beautiful and colorful towels will noticed at the beach with friends, at the pool with family, or even after a nice bath or shower. Each towel is high quality and they are the softest and plushest towels you will find in the market. Their softness, and high absorbency will deliver to you the best towel experience. These high-quality towels offer: - A superb luxurious feel.  - Value, unlike any other set sold online.  - 100% Combed ring-spun weave for a luxurious feeling  - Superb absorbency and comfort.

- Wash towels separately from other items of clothing to help decrease the transfer of towel lint to other pieces of clothing. - Use cold water to wash towels to avoid color bleeding. - Always use a mild detergent when washing towels. You may use a larger amount of detergent on towels that are heavily soiled. - Do not use fabric softeners. They may decrease the fluffiness and life of your towel by breaking down the fabric. - Do not use bleach at any stage of washing or drying. Doing so may discolor your towels and damage the fabric.
